thread:
rachel: Quick follow-up from the streaming postmortem: we saw recurring partial responses and timeouts on /v1/stream. Need owners and short deadlines.

omar: I'll take the client SDK defaults (make safer reconnects + idempotent resend). ETA 48h.

lee: I'll do a small runtime guard: add a 500ms reconnect acceptance window + a short mutex around KV invalidation. ETA 72h.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-2026-099 created and linked to previous incidents (INC-2025-200, INC-2025-402). Pattern match 79%.

dina: Observability gap: we don't correlate session_id between LB and runtime. I'll add propagation and a dashboard panel for partial_response_rate vs kv_evictions. ETA 36h.

omar: SDK plan: default expo backoff with jitter, expose RECONNECT_MAX_MS, and send idempotency_token on resend. Snippet: `connect({base:200, max:2000, jitter:0.25, idempotency:true})`

lee: Runtime metric `kv_evictions_per_min` and alert if > 12/min on a host. Also add server-side acceptance of idempotency tokens for reconnects.

dina: Dashboard will include: partial_response_rate, kv_evictions_per_min, reconnects_per_min, handshake_latency_p95. Add alert: partial_response_rate > 0.4% for 15m.

ops-bot: Runbook note added: when partials spike, check session reserve, eviction rate, and recent deploys.

rachel: Owners summary: client=omar (2d), runtime=lee (3d), observability=dina (1.5d). Regression test: simulate eviction during active stream assigned to omar+lee (3d).

omar: I'll open PRs today and include a playback test to force eviction mid-stream.

lee: I'll prepare canary plan: 5% for 12h, monitor partial_response_rate and CPU, then 25% for 24h. If rates worsen >20% revert.

rachel: Follow-up sync in 3 business days 10:00. Please bring PR links and canary gating criteria. :thumbsup:
